summary.text: Junelle Cavero, a Democrat, represents District 11 in the Arizona House of Representatives, to which the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors appointed her in April 2024 to replace Marcelino Quinonez, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: She lives in Arizona, earned a bachelor's degree from New York University and a master's degree from American University.
Her career experience includes working as a CEO, executive director, and consultant.
